g.desc: If the firewall has advanced features like deep packet inspec...
g.text: If the firewall has advanced features like deep packet inspection, it can look deeper into the packet’s payload.

g.title: Sheet.62
g.desc: A firewall inspects packets up to the layer 4 header, checkin...
g.text: A firewall inspects packets up to the layer 4 header, checking IP addresses and TCP/UDP ports to decide whether to allow or block traffic (hence, “working at layer 4").
